meta.name: block-no-verify-hook
meta.description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.

copy.tagline: 禁止 AI 代理绕过 Git 提交检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude Code 项目中强制提交质量检查。
copy.tagline_en: Block AI agents from skipping pre-commit checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce commit quality gates in Claude Code projects.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 执行 git 操作时,如果命令里带有 --no-verify 或 --no-gpg-sign 等跳过检查的选项,会被直接拒绝,并提示改用正常命令,确保代码检查与签名校验不会绕过。
howto.when: 当 Claude 通过 Bash 工具执行含 git 的命令,并且命令里带 --no-verify 或 --no-gpg-sign 时触发拦截。

say.note: 该命令会被拒绝,提示不允许跳过检查
Claude 会说明这是 hook 的拦截规则

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude's git commands containing bypass flags like --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign are blocked before execution, forcing pre-commit hooks and signing checks to run.
howto.when_en: The hook triggers when Claude runs a Bash tool call that includes a git command with --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign flags, either directly or after &&, ;, or |.

say_en.note: If Claude tries --no-verify, the hook blocks it.
The command is rejected and explained.
